title: Man Evades Police to Care for His Grandmother, Bad Idea
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On May 1, 2023, a Monroe County deputy in Warrens, WI, attempted to pull over a vehicle with no license plates and a loud exhaust. The driver evaded the deputy and engaged in a chase. Spike strips were used, causing him to crash into a ditch and flee on foot. However, the driver was apprehended shortly afterward. During an interview, he mentioned caring for his grandmother and a warrant as motives for fleeing.

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
